Under the baseline alone there would be no paydown — so the tree exists only for a reader who finds the factor documents from the records (second_home occupancy, FarmLand records, farmstead_split release, months open, fees_due, autopay with near due date).
- Closest alternatives: limit on 315000 at 80% (baseline) — excluded by the value-basis and occupancy factors; tested balance on principal alone — excluded by fees unpaid 15.00 and the autopay rule; fee rate on the pre-paydown LTV 82.31 (0.4%) — excluded by the recording order; fee on principal balance — excluded by the basis factor (29 months).
